propositions: When evidence search exhausts its step budget without refuting any criterion (insufficiency-only FAIL), the gate should auto-resume the verifier instead of surfacing failure to the operator.

Auto-resume qualification reuses the existing _insufficiency_only predicate with no schema or prompt changes; a resumption dispatches only when all unmet criteria carry the framework-derived evidence_sufficient:false marker.
Resumption is bounded by verify.auto_resume_max count (default 2, 0 disables) and by strict progress—a re-run proceeds only if the prior attempt strictly increased the cache-credited PASS count.
The resumption loop sits at the shared close-gate seam (close_precheck._completion_precheck wrapping llm.verify_completion), so CLI, MCP, and library closes all exercise it.

Per-attempt trail (attempt number, cache-credited count, remaining unmet count) is recorded on the verdict sidecar and visible in close output; exhaustion after bounded resumptions surfaces the existing failure with an attempts-count message.
